summary: First full test iteration on RecrutAI. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed covering auth (login/register/me/duplicate/invalid), jobs CRUD (create/read/update/delete + admin-only), applications flow (create with CV upload, list mine, admin list, status update pending->accepted, invalid status 400, CV download admin allowed / other candidate 403, delete), candidates listing, chat (candidate->admin, admin->candidate polling), theme get/put + forbidden for candidate, admin stats, AI chat (Claude Sonnet 4.6 returning French reply, non-fallback). Frontend: end-to-end UI flow verified via Playwright - admin login lands on /admin dashboard with stats; admin publishes a new job via dialog and it appears in list; theme change (Bleu Corporate) applied and PERSISTED across reload (--primary CSS var == '220 100% 33%'); unauth hitting /dashboard redirected to /login; candidate register lands on /dashboard; candidate hitting /admin is redirected to /dashboard (role separation OK); candidate submits application via job detail page (/job/{id}) with CV PDF upload; candidate dashboard immediately shows the application with 'En attente' badge and 'Reçue / En attente' timeline step; AI chat widget opens with tabs (Assistant IA + Support), messages sent successfully; Support tab conversation works. No blocking issues observed.

issues: Toast 'Bienvenue Administrateur!' overlaps the top-right area (may briefly cover parts of the header) but auto-dismisses; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 700+ lines and mixes auth, storage, jobs, applications, chat, AI, and theme in a single module. Consider splitting into routers/services for maintainability.

delete_candidate deletes chat messages using conversation_id == user_id, which matches candidate-side conversations only. Since conversation_id is always the candidate's user_id, this is correct, but the code comment/name is slightly misleading.
AI fallback silently returns 200 with generic 'souci technique' message on LLM error, which may hide upstream failures. Consider returning a 502 or including an error flag for the frontend.
/api/ai/chat is unauthenticated. Any anonymous caller can consume LLM tokens. Consider requiring at least Bearer auth or rate-limiting per session.
Applications endpoint reads entire CV/voice into memory (await cv.read()) without size limit. Add MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE check to prevent memory abuse.
CORS is configured with allow_origins='*' from env default. Since credentials aren't used (Bearer token), this is acceptable, but explicit allow-list recommended for production.
delete_job / delete_candidate return {ok: true} even when id doesn't exist (idempotent, but no 404). Optional to tighten.
hexToHsl in AdminDashboard doesn't validate hex length -> silent NaN if user pastes short/invalid value in custom color Input.
